business_summary: Semba Tohka Industries Co., Ltd engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of food ingredients primarily in Japan. It offers caramel products, such as caramel color and roasted products; dried products, including powdered tea, powdered soy sauces, powdered yams, and freeze-dried vegetables; assembled products, including corn soup, powdered sauce, miso soup, and wheat flour products; frozen products such as frozen yam and frozen Japanese confectionery, and other purchased products; granulated and blended products; and processed food materials and food additives. It also sells its products online. The company serves food manufacturers, as well as commercial and general consumers. Semba Tohka Industries Co., Ltd was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Moka, Japan.
